entries.title: Authority

entries.title: Margins
entries.approved_rule: Use left 3.0 cm; right 2.5 cm; top 2.5 cm; bottom 2.5 cm.

entries.title: Body font
entries.approved_rule: Use exact Times New Roman, 12 pt, regular, black for normal text. Production builds must verify that a Times New Roman face is embedded in the PDF.

entries.title: Font fallback
entries.approved_rule: A compatibility fallback may be enabled only as an explicitly logged non-production mode. It must never silently replace Times New Roman in a submission build.
entries.evidence_note: Production uses exact Times New Roman, fallback requires explicit PUPreviewTinosFont; production PDF embeds Times New Roman

entries.title: Line spacing
entries.approved_rule: Use 1.5 line spacing for normal thesis prose.

entries.title: Hyphenation
entries.approved_rule: Do not break words across lines by hyphenation.

entries.title: Paragraphs
entries.approved_rule: Use zero global first-line indentation and zero global paragraph-after spacing. Do not invent a thesis-wide indent not supported by PU sources.
entries.evidence_note: Style parindent=0 and parskip=0, intentional four-space abstract exception

entries.title: Abstract indent
entries.approved_rule: Apply an approximately four-space first-line indent specifically to abstract paragraphs, reflecting the PU abstract instruction.

entries.title: Chapter opening
